bull_bear.body:
- Healthy debt-to-equity ratio of 0.4x is cited as providing headroom for future growth.
- Strong cash generation stated as supporting strategic investments and business expansion; cash & cash equivalents of Rs 84.8 Cr in FY26 (Rs 78.2 Cr FY25, Rs 104.8 Cr FY23).
- ROE & ROCE expansion is targeted via operating leverage and better asset utilisation rather than new capital deployment.
- Balance sheet shows long-term borrowings falling from Rs 107.5 Cr at Mar'21 to Rs 36.9 Cr at Mar'26, while short-term borrowings stood at Rs 220.3 Cr at Mar'26.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Described as the LARGEST PRODUCER of Ductile Iron Castings and a TOP 10 PRODUCER of Grey Iron Castings in India, and as the ONLY casting manufacturer with a product range from 0.5-400Kg (a separate slide instead describes a one-stop shop for Grey Iron, Ductile Iron and Austempered Ductile Iron 'ranging from 0.5 Kg to 500 Kg').
- Strong customer positioning claimed, with ~80% of export products and 50-60% of domestic products being single-sourced; distinguished customer base of more than 40 customers including OEMs and Tier 1 companies (TAFE, Tata Motors, DANA, Ashok Leyland, Automotive Axles, Meritor and others).
- Nelcast is 'among only a few companies in the industry capable of meeting the requirements of top global OEMs & Tier 1s', exporting machined castings to North America, Europe and Southeast Asia.
- Strategic location cited as a moat: plants are 37-140 KM from Chennai (a key customer base and a reliable source of steel scrap), all 3 plants are within 15-110KM of India's largest source of Silica Sand near Gudur, and are close to Krishnapatnam & Chennai seaports.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Exports] Deck states that in FY26 exports were impacted by slowdown in the U.S. economy amid geo-political headwinds; the journey slide notes Nelcast crossed the Rs 400 Crores mark in exports in FY24.
- [Board] Chaired by Vinod K Dasari (ex-MD Timken India, joint MD Cummins India, CEO/MD Ashok Leyland and Royal Enfield); board includes R. Sridharan (ex-MD & Group Executive of SBI, MD of Clearing Corporation of India) and founder-family directors; P. Deepak is Managing Director.
- [End-market outlook] India's tractor industry recorded highest-ever annual sales in FY26 with wholesale dispatches of 11.6 lakh units (up 23.5% YoY) and Crisil projects ~12 lakh units in FY27; M&HCV volumes of about 4.22 lakh units in FY26 are expected to grow a modest 5-7% in FY27.
- [Segment mix] Tractor segment contribution increased to 27.1% of revenues in Q1FY27 from 23.5% in Q1FY26, with M&HCV remaining the largest revenue contributor.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Nelcast as a leading Indian producer of Ductile & Grey Iron Castings with 160,000 MT/year of installed capacity, supplying 40+ OEM and Tier-1 customers across Commercial Vehicles, Tractors, Off-Highway Equipment, Railways and Passenger Vehicles, with a growing export presence in North America, Europe and Southeast Asia.
